protocol.functional: PBE (E2 setting; no dispersion for an isolated monolayer)
protocol.geometry_basis: bulk black P (Brown & Rundqvist 1965, Cmce); archived E2 P4/P36/P35 have no P-P bond below 2.5 A (puckering placed on the zigzag axis)
protocol.kpoints: Gamma-centered; E2 8x11x1 unit-cell density, ceil(8/nx) x ceil(11/ny) x 1
protocol.relaxation: ISIF=3 with LATTICE_CONSTRAINTS=T T F (in-plane cell only)
protocol.spin: ISPIN=2, MAGMOM 0.5 per atom (vacancies leave unpaired electrons)
